messages:
Maya Chen: Initiating Pegasus-Sentinel tenant swap to Dedicated on 2026-08-14 22:00 UTC. Requesting go/no-go.

DeployBot: deploybot: scheduled swap job 2849991111 created by maya. Canaries: 3 pods. Expected duration 18m.

Carlo Ruiz: SRE checklist: canary traffic 5%, latency SLO 150ms p99. Rollback threshold: error rate >1.5% sustained 3m. Agree?

Priya Singh: @carlo yes. Also need KMS key rotation window confirmed by security.

Amir Khan: Ops: Backup snapshot done at 2026-08-14T21:30Z (snap-peg-08-14). DB migration plan uses read-only fallback; we should pin runtime to v1.8.2-pegasus-rc.

Maya Chen: Pin request: v1.8.2-pegasus-rc. Will hold if any mismatch.

DeployBot: deploybot: running preflight checks...
- capacity: OK
- model pin: v1.8.2-pegasus-rc
- KMS: UNKNOWN
- quotas: OK
Preflight failed: KMS integration missing auth header.

Priya Singh: Security: KMS auth fixed. Re-ran test, all green.

Carlo Ruiz: Reminder: Canary slice = dedicated-slice-7, monitor ops-console/pegasus-sentinel/canary. I'll watch metrics.

Maya Chen: Start canary at 22:00 UTC. If p99 > 200ms or 5xx spikes, initiate rollback. @deploybot please tag release_notes: 'pegasus dedicated swap v1.8.2'

DeployBot: deploybot: canary started. canary-id c-8221.

SRE-Jen: Watching. Noted minor latency blip at +4m (p50+12ms) but stable.

Amir Khan: DB lag held under 50ms. No schema change.

Carlo Ruiz: Canary healthy at +15m. shifting 25% traffic.

Maya Chen: 0 issues. Approve full roll to 100% between +20-30m.

Priya Singh: :thumbsup: Security audit logs are flowing to SIEM, KMS access logged.

DeployBot: deploybot: traffic move to 100% scheduled, ETA +25m.

DeployBot: deploybot: migration complete. all pods reported healthy. metrics: p99=128ms, error-rate 0.2%.

Maya Chen: Marking go. Noted we must follow up with release note doc and client notice.

Carlo Ruiz: Post-rollout actions: 1) Remove canary slice 2) Start 24h incident watch 3) Schedule debrief tomorrow 09:30 PST.

Priya Singh: I'll file the security postmortem checklist items and KMS rotation task.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. Closing thread. :tada:
